payload.explanation: The business request (session_98e87fc169c2, pid 543, UPDATE inventory stock-1 for product_id=2) is blocked on transactionid by pid 540 (session_f2c5b6b59d3c), which itself is blocked on transactionid by pid 541 (session_0ca3dcbe5c8b). The root blocker session_0ca3dcbe5c8b is 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead after having executed an UPDATE on inventory — it holds row locks and never committed. Tracing the full chain: 98e87fc169c2 -> f2c5b6b59d3c -> 0ca3dcbe5c8b. No evidence of large data, missing indexes (PK exists), or vacuum issues; the two idle-in-transaction SELECT 1 sessions (d7408f69345c, 456c63e51aee) hold no blocking locks. Resolution: rollback the eligible root blocker session_0ca3dcbe5c8b, which releases the lock chain and lets the business request complete. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
